checklist: Order ID / invoice or payment screenshot
Seller or platform communication (chat / email)
Bank statement or UPI reference for the payment
Photos or unboxing video if the product is defective
Written request already sent to the seller (if any)
steps: Collect order proof and written follow-up with the seller.
Lodge the grievance on NCH 2.0 (consumerhelpline.gov.in) or call 1915.
Keep the NCH docket number for follow-up.
If unresolved, consider the Consumer Commission path using the same evidence pack.

department: Urban Local Body / Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (escalation)
checklist: Exact location (ward, street, landmark, PIN)
Photographs of the damaged road or civic defect
Date first noticed and any prior complaint number
Safety impact (accidents, flooding, blocked ambulance access)
steps: Note the exact location and take dated photographs.
File first with the municipal corporation / local civic app if available.
If there is no response, lodge a public grievance on CPGRAMS (pgportal.gov.in).
Save the registration number in the NyayaSetu tracker.

department: State Power Distribution Company / Electricity Ombudsman
checklist: Consumer / CA number on the electricity bill
Latest bill and payment receipt
Meter reading photograph (if billing dispute)
Outage dates and duration (if supply issue)
steps: Call or use the DISCOM app/portal with your consumer number.
Escalate internally using the complaint number.
If still unresolved, approach the Electricity Ombudsman / CGRF of your state.
Central public grievances can also be recorded on CPGRAMS.

authority_name: Municipal Jal Board / Water Supply Department
department: Urban Local Body Water Supply Wing
checklist: Consumer / connection number
Ward and exact address
Photos of leakage, tanker delay, or contaminated water
Prior complaint IDs if any
steps: Register the complaint with the local Jal Board / municipality.
Keep the docket number and follow up after the stated SLA.
Escalate on CPGRAMS if local redressal fails.

helpline: Bank customer care, then RBI CMS
department: Reserve Bank of India — Integrated Ombudsman Scheme
checklist: UPI / NEFT / card reference number
Bank statement screenshot (mask account number except last 4 digits)
Date, time, and amount of the transaction
Bank complaint number from first-level grievance
steps: Raise a complaint with your bank / UPI app first and wait for the bank's timeline.
If unresolved, file on RBI CMS (cms.rbi.org.in) under the Integrated Ombudsman Scheme.
For suspected cyber fraud, also call 1930 and report on cybercrime.gov.in.

department: Ministry of Home Affairs — Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre
checklist: Transaction IDs, UTR, and amount lost
Screenshots of chats, SMS, or fake websites (do not share OTP)
Bank / wallet name and time of fraud
Copy of any 1930 acknowledgement
steps: Call 1930 immediately for financial fraud so the beneficiary account can be considered for freezing.
File a complaint on https://cybercrime.gov.in/.
Inform your bank in writing with the cyber complaint number.
Never share OTP, PIN, or remote-access of your device with anyone claiming to help.

checklist: Category of need (education, agriculture, health, housing)
State of residence and rural/urban status
Indicative eligibility documents (do not upload here)
Official scheme code from myScheme if already identified
steps: Search eligible schemes on https://www.myscheme.gov.in/.
Open only official .gov.in application links listed there.
Prepare documents listed on the official scheme page before applying.

helpline: Facility helpdesk / 104 (state health helpline where available)
department: State Health Department / Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
checklist: Hospital / PHC name and date of visit
OPD / IPD number if issued
Summary of the service issue (no full medical records uploaded here)
Prior complaint to the hospital superintendent
steps: Raise the issue with the hospital grievance cell first.
Use the state health helpline where available.
Escalate on CPGRAMS if there is no response.

department: Ministry of Education / State Education Department
checklist: Student name as on school records (do not share passwords)
Institute name and academic year
Scholarship / exam application ID if already created on the official portal
Screenshots of error messages (no OTP)
steps: Use only official portals such as scholarships.gov.in or the state education site.
Raise a grievance with the institute nodal officer.
Escalate on CPGRAMS for department-level service failures.
